title: Check Memory Usage
description: Check RAM utilization and report when memory usage is high.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

THRESHOLD="${THRESHOLD:-80}"

MEMORY_USAGE=$(free | awk '/Mem:/ {
    printf "%.0f", ($3/$2)*100
}')

echo "Memory Usage: ${MEMORY_USAGE}%"

if (( MEMORY_USAGE >= THRESHOLD )); then
    echo "WARNING: Memory usage is above ${THRESHOLD}%"
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: Memory usage is normal."
